scope: Exploratory offline study on recorded simulator runs: candidate sensor readings re-cast on the CPU at recorded and displaced tool poses. Not a registered result; no threshold here is final.

definitions.truth_between_jaws: any of nine segments across the jaw gap intersects the target component
definitions.truth_at_mouth_centre: the segment through the mouth centre intersects the target component
definitions.truth_note: the first pass used only the mouth-centre segment; both are reported after seeing it is not on the target at closure in any run
